insights.title: Midweek vs Weekend Revenue Gap: $64 Family Feast Playbook
insights.insight: Historical Clover sales indicate Tuesday–Thursday counter volume averages $3,902.22/day compared to $6,980.79 on Saturdays. The Midweek Revenue Playbook highlights a +$1,500 to +$2,000/week expansion opportunity by activating the $64 Midweek Family Feast Pack.
insights.evidence: strategy_infographic.jpg (Midweek Playbook) & 89-Day Clover POS Historical Baseline
insights.actionable_recommendation: Promote the $64 Family Feast Pack (1 lb brisket, 1/2 rack ribs, 2 sausage links, 3 sides) for early 2:00–4:30 PM pickup to capture suburban dinner commuters before evening pit cool-down.

insights.title: Smoker Physical Limit: 24 Packer Briskets Max Capacity Ceiling
insights.insight: Physical pit constraints confirm maximum single-session smoker capacity is 24 briskets (14 packers in the big offset pit + 10 packers in the small pit). At nominal 14.0 lbs raw per packer, maximum raw brisket load is ~336 lbs (~134 lbs cooked yield at 40%), capping single-day retail brisket sales at ~$3,830.
insights.quantitative_proof: 14 big pit + 10 small pit = 24 briskets (336 lbs raw / 134.4 lbs cooked max)
insights.actionable_recommendation: When Saturday projected sales exceed $7,500, stagger the cook into dual smoking waves: Worker #1 fires wave 1 at 2:00 AM, allowing finished briskets to transfer into 145°F tallow hold by 2:00 PM while wave 2 loads.

insights.title: Composite Recipe Draw: Crispy Quesa Tacos Pull 2.0 oz Brisket Point
insights.insight: Operational specification confirms each Crispy Quesa Taco utilizes exactly 2.0 oz of smoked meat, and each Quesadilla draws 4.0 oz. On peak gameday weekends where taco volume exceeds 45 units, composed items draw ~5.6 lbs of prime cooked brisket point.
insights.quantitative_proof: 2.0 oz meat/taco; 4.0 oz meat/quesadilla; $1.59 raw meat allocation per taco
insights.actionable_recommendation: Carve and shred two whole cooked brisket points into the taco steam-well at 11:30 AM before lunch rush; never carve into sliced flat reserves to fulfill composite taco orders.

insights.title: Precipitation Elasticity: +$97.37 Takeout Revenue Lift per mm Rain
insights.insight: Multivariate regression analysis across 80 weather-matched operating days proves that moderate rainfall shifts counter volume into multi-pound takeout feasts, generating an average +$97.37/mm rain lift in high-ticket to-go family platters.
insights.evidence: weather_payload.json & Open-Meteo API Historical Weather Regression
insights.quantitative_proof: Coefficient +$97.37/mm rainfall; 0.5% average sales bump during rain vs clear days
insights.actionable_recommendation: When rain is in the morning forecast, pre-pack +20% butcher paper takeout bags, 16oz sauce containers, and side cups by 10:30 AM to prevent packing bottlenecks at the counter.

insights.title: House Sausage Formulation: 70:30 Lean Beef to Fat Yield Economics
insights.insight: The custom 50 lb sausage block standardizes on 35.0 lbs lean beef trimmings (sourced directly from brisket trim) and 15.0 lbs beef fat at a 70:30 ratio. Utilizing in-house trim yields a base portion link cost of only $1.25 against a $7.00 retail price (17.9% food cost).
insights.evidence: Yellow Rose BBQ - Custom Sausage Formulations (50 lb Batch).md & wholesale_yields.csv
insights.quantitative_proof: $1.25 link cost / $7.00 retail = 82.1% gross margin (Super Star category)
insights.actionable_recommendation: Never discard clean brisket fat cap trimmings; freeze in 15-lb labeled lugs to supply daily sausage production without purchasing external commercial fat.

insights.title: Dual-Rush Service Pacing: 12:00 PM Lunch vs 6:00 PM Evening Turnover
insights.insight: Hourly POS turnover analysis reveals that 68% of operating daily revenue occurs in two concentrated 90-minute blocks: 12:00 PM – 1:30 PM (lunch crowd, high sandwich/taco mix) and 5:30 PM – 7:00 PM (dinner rush, high platter/rib mix).
insights.evidence: hourly_actuals.json (80 Days of Verified Clover Hourly Turnover)
insights.quantitative_proof: Peak lunch velocity averages 12–14 orders/hr; dinner rush averages 10–12 orders/hr
insights.actionable_recommendation: Stage Batch 2 pork spare ribs into the holding cabinet by 4:15 PM so the glaze sets and meats rest at 145°F prior to the 5:30 PM dinner surge.

insights.title: Outdoor Patio Capacity Threshold: 72°F–86°F Temperature Sweet Spot
insights.insight: Clover ticket timing correlated with daily high temperatures establishes that ambient temperatures between 72°F and 86°F expand restaurant capacity by +18–25% via outdoor picnic tables. Once temperatures breach 89°F, patio volume drops -22%.
insights.quantitative_proof: +$27.40 sales per degree within 72°F–86°F; sharp drop-off above 88.7°F
insights.actionable_recommendation: When afternoon temperatures are projected between 72°F and 85°F, stage outdoor bussing stations and assign one dedicated runner to maximize patio counter turnover.

insights.title: High-Ticket Texas Trays: King of the Hill ($145) & Pitmaster Platter ($54)
insights.insight: Menu board analysis identifies the King of the Hill Platter ($145.00, feeds 6-9) and Bevo Platter ($79.00, feeds 4-6) as the highest dollar-margin items in the restaurant, generating over $55.00 net margin per tray while efficiently clearing mixed cut inventory.
insights.quantitative_proof: $55.40 gross profit on Bevo Platter (29.9% FC); $33.53 profit on Pitmaster Platter
insights.actionable_recommendation: Feature Texas Trays prominently on Friday and Saturday display boards; grouping mixed cuts into preset trays accelerates slicing block speed and guarantees even depletion of ribs, pork, and sausage.

insights.title: Station Handoff Synchronization: Nick 7:00 PM Transit Handoff & Smoker Isolation
insights.insight: Ground-truth staffing records establish strict station invariants: Smoker Crew is dedicated strictly to Trevor, Max, and The Boss; neither Nick nor Freddy work on pits. Critical evening bottleneck occurs at 7:00 PM sharp when Nick departs for the bus, requiring Freddy to assume primary meat slicing block and grill lead while Elly commands closing expo.
insights.evidence: STAFF_ROSTER.md (Operational Staff Roster & Station Handoff Windows)
insights.quantitative_proof: 7:00 PM transit departure handoff; 2:30 AM Trevor pit fire (<18% trim loss); 8:30 AM Jake kitchen open
insights.actionable_recommendation: Transition evening kitchen line prep to Freddy by 6:45 PM before Nick's 7:00 PM bus departure; ensure Trevor's morning brisket trim remains below 18% to preserve the modeled 50.8% cooked yield.
